message: Agent 2 records source_format 'free' (divisions start in column 1, entries in column 4); lines were read as whole-line program text. Lines 3-9 begin with '*' and are comments.

COPY ERRHND (line 16) sits under 01 WS-ERROR-AREA, EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA (line 19) under 01 WS-DB2-AREA and COPY ERRHND (line 35) under LINKAGE 01 DFHCOMMAREA, but the copybook records ERROR-HANDLING and SQL-STATUS-CODES are themselves level 01. Registered as EXPANDS_COPY from the enclosing 01 records (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0062-REC-0001, -REC-0002, -REC-0004) as written; their total_bytes (174, 35, 174) include the copybook records and their inline_bytes is 0.

EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA (line 19) expands to copybook SQLCA (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0017), which defines only SQL-STATUS-CODES (35 bytes). The precompiler SQLCA items (SQLCODE, SQLSTATE, ...) are not defined in the repository copybook.
EXEC SQL BEGIN/END DECLARE SECTION (lines 22 and 31) sits inside 01 WS-ERRLOG-RECORD; its 05-level host variables are recorded as ordinary children of WS-ERRLOG-RECORD.

Copybook ERRHND is expanded twice: line 16 (WORKING-STORAGE, under WS-ERROR-AREA) and line 35 (LINKAGE, under DFHCOMMAREA). Both expansions point to the same copybook record SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0019-REC-0001; each has its own USES_COPYBOOK/EXPANDS_COPY keyed by line.
